opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries or be in a position to influence these industries; aged between 25 and 45 (upper age limit 45 on 31st July in the year of application); no academic qualifications required; well established in career, three years post tertiary education; resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or work directly for UK agriculture; not in full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Awarded to approximately 25 individuals each year to research topics of interest in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry. Scholars conduct a study tour anywhere in the world for a minimum of 8 weeks, then present findings in a written report, video and presentation at the Nuffield Farming Conference. Includes a £9,000 bursary plus professional and leadership development (conference tickets, industry leaders seminar, Contemporary Scholars Conference, professional development training, networking).

opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24; open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A scholarship to develop young talent in agriculture, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. Includes a 30-day study programme (June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, Nuffield Farming Associate membership, and a £1,000 financial incentive to part-cover replacement labour cost. 2027 plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
